platforms.purpose: Retrieve arXiv preprints as platform-native papers: versioned identity, metadata, abstract, and full text.
platforms.select_when: The request names arXiv, supplies an arxiv.org URL or arxiv: ref, or needs arXiv papers rather than general web pages.
examples: find recent arXiv papers on retrieval evaluation
